feedback.worked_solution:
We split the integral into the sum of two integrals and factor out the constants. We get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-7}^{-5}(2{f}^{′}(x)-4)\,\text{d}x & =2{\int }_{-7}^{-5}{f}^{′}(x)\,\text{d}x-4{\int }_{-7}^{-5}\,\text{d}x \\  & =2f(x)\,{|}_{-7}^{-5}-4x\,{|}_{-7}^{-5} \\  & =2(f(-5)-f(-7))-4(-5-(-7)) \\  & =2((1+2\sqrt{2})-1)-8 \\  & =2(1+2\sqrt{2}-1)-8 \\  & =4\sqrt{2}-8.\end{aligned}
$$
